lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pr₂Sb₂ (PrSb) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with four atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Pr and Sb centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Pr coordinated by 8 Pr and 4 Sb neighbors, and Sb by 4 Pr and 8 Sb neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all four sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Pr 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Pr and Sb polyhedra.
